datasets.title: Differentially expressed lncRNA in biological premature ovarian insufficiency (bPOI)
datasets.summary: Our study is designed to demonstrate altered profiles of lncRNAs in the granulosa cells from patients with bPOI. Functional studies will be further confirmed. This study will provide new viewpoint for understanding the roles of non-coding RNA for GCs function, as well as potential etiologic mechanism for POI.
datasets.overall_design: We have completed the human LncRNA microarray analysis of the 20 samples.

datasets.study_design: bPOI患者与正常对照的颗粒细胞，lncRNA芯片差异分析

evidence.relevant: 标题和摘要均以bPOI为研究主体，样本轴为bPOI患者与健康对照的颗粒细胞，直接研究POI相关lncRNA差异表达。
evidence.sequencing_type: 实验设计明确为lncRNA芯片；Agilent Feature Extraction处理array图像、GeneSpring归一化，无测序证据，靶向lncRNA，故为lncRNA microarray

evidence.treatment: 比较轴为bPOI vs 正常对照，无药物干预

evidence.correlation: bPOI患者仅10例，不足16例，无法做患者级相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: 所有20个样本的source/cell type均为从卵巢卵泡分离的颗粒细胞(granulosa cells)，属于分离出的具体细胞类型，直接提RNA检测，符合primary_cell定义。

datasets.title: Differentially expressed miRNA in biological premature ovarian insufficiency (bPOI)
datasets.organism: JC polyomavirus; Human immunodeficiency virus 1; Merkel cell polyomavirus; Cytomegalovirus; Betapolyomavirus macacae; Homo sapiens; Rhadinovirus; Betapolyomavirus hominis; Human alphaherpesvirus 1; Human alphaherpesvirus 2; Lymphocryptovirus
datasets._705eef: SOGEN索臻·此为免费流传版·完整增量更新在学科/专题私域群(入群20元防广告)·sogentech.com
datasets.summary: We first examined changes of miRNAs and expression using microarrays ( Exiqon miRCURY™ microarray LNA v.18.0) of GCs from 10 bPOI and 10 age and BMI matched normal control women. Seventy-five miRNAs (Fold Change [FC]>2, P<0.05) were identified differentially expressed between bPOI patients and control women.
datasets.overall_design: Our study is designed to demonstrate altered profiles of miRNAs in the granulosa cells from patients with bPOI. Functional studies will be further confirmed. This study will provide new viewpoint for understanding the roles of non-coding RNA for GCs function, as well as potential etiologic mechanism for POI.

evidence.relevant: 样本为bPOI患者颗粒细胞，研究主体即POI本身的miRNA机制，两轴均直接满足。
evidence.sequencing_type: 芯片为Exiqon miRCURY LNA microRNA array，专门捕获miRNA；读出为GenePix扫描荧光信号，属array；总RNA提取自颗粒细胞群体，bulk分辨率。
evidence.survival_analysis: GSM临床字段仅有cell type、disease state、sex、source，无随访时间（如os_time）和生存状态（如vital_status）字段，无法进行生存分析。
evidence.treatment: 观察性研究，仅比较bPOI患者与正常对照颗粒细胞miRNA差异，无治疗干预。
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: disease state字段明确分为control(10)和bPOI(10)，对照为年龄BMI匹配的正常女性颗粒细胞，独立于疾病组，排除P1–P6陷阱。
evidence.correlation: 平台关通过（miRNA microarray），但目标疾病bPOI患者仅10例，未达>15阈值，不足以支撑表达相关性分析。
evidence.sample_source: 所有20个GSM的source/characteristics均为granulosa cells，是从卵泡液中分离的特定原代细胞类型，离体后直接提取RNA检测miRNA，未进行体外培养，按规则应判定为primary_cell。

datasets.title: miRNA expression profiles in plasma-derived exosomes of patients with premature ovarian failure
datasets.summary: Exosomes are extracellular vesicles that have been shown to have therapeutic effects. However, the role of plasma-derived exosomal miRNA in premature ovarian failure (POF) remains ambiguous. To investigate the epigenetic pathogenesis in POF, we analyzed the expression profile of miRNA in exosomes derived from plasma of health control and POF patients using RNA sequencing.
datasets.overall_design: A total of 10 samples were collected, including 4 healthy control subjects and 6 patients with POF.
datasets.study_design: POF患者与健康对照血浆外泌体miRNA-seq差异表达分析
datasets.relevance_reason: 使用POF患者血浆来源外泌体miRNA表达谱

evidence.sample_source: 所有10例样本均取自外周血，提取血浆中的外泌体后进行miRNA测序，未经细胞培养或特定细胞类型分选，属于血液直接组分。

datasets.title: Differences in miRNA expression profiles of follicular fluid exosomes between Premature ovarian insufficiency and normal ovarian reserve
datasets.summary: Premature ovarian insufficiency (POI) refers to the severe decline and failure of ovarian function in women before the age of 40, and current treatment methods have significant limitations. In order to screen miRNAs with good anti-apoptotic effect, we used high-throughput sequencing technology to study the differences in  exosomal miRNA expression profiles from human follicular fluid between patients with POI and patients with normal ovarian reserve.
datasets.overall_design: In order to screen miRNAs with good anti-apoptotic effect from human follicular fluid exosomes, we selected three cases of follicular fluid from POI patients and three cases of follicular fluid from control group patients, extracted follicular fluid exosomes, extracted total RNA of exosomes, and screened 18-30nt sRNA for high-throughput sequencing.
datasets.study_design: POI患者与正常卵巢储备女性卵泡液外泌体miRNA-seq差异表达分析
datasets.relevance_reason: 直接比较POI与正常卵巢储备的卵泡液外泌体miRNA

evidence.relevant: POI vs 正常卵巢储备的卵泡液外泌体 miRNA 差异研究，样本来自 POI 患者，疾病是明确主体且样本轴满足。
evidence.sequencing_type: 提取外泌体总RNA后筛选18-30nt小RNA进行高通量测序，目标明确为miRNA表达谱，符合miRNA-seq机制
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本数仅6且缺乏生存时间/状态字段，无法生存分析
evidence.treatment: 核心比较为POI vs 正常卵巢储备，无药物治疗干预
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 对照组为“patients with normal ovarian reserve”（卵巢储备正常患者），并非独立真健康供者，无法正向确认其为健康个体，按从严原则判false。
evidence.correlation: POI患者仅3例，远低于16例最低要求，无法做表达相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: 所有GSM均为从人卵泡液中提取的外泌体，卵泡液属于非血液体液，按指南患者体液来源外泌体归body_fluid。

datasets.title: Identify urinary exosome microRNAs that are unique to premature ovarian insufficiency
datasets.summary: This study is to identify urinary exosome microRNAs (miRNAs) that are unique to premature ovarian insufficiency  (POI) with and without Turner syndrome and to use them as diagnostic markers for POI patients. We examined the miRNAexpression profile in urine exosomes from POI patients with and without Turner syndrome.
datasets.overall_design: We analyzed the miRNA expression profile isolated from the urinary exosomes of POI patients with or without Turner syndrome.
datasets.study_design: POI患者（伴/不伴Turner综合征）与正常个体尿液外泌体miRNA测序差异分析
datasets.relevance_reason: 直接使用POI患者尿液外泌体寻找诊断性miRNA标志物

evidence.relevant: 主体为POI尿外泌体诊断标志物研究，样本来自POI患者（含Turner综合征）和正常个体，两轴均通过。
evidence.sequencing_type: 样本提取外泌体总RNA，经过size fractionation富集小RNA，针对miRNA进行高通量测序，目的为分析miRNA表达谱，符合miRNA-seq定义。
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本为POI患者尿外泌体，无任何生存时间或状态字段，无法做生存分析
evidence.treatment: 比较的是POI患者亚型与正常对照，无药物/干预对照轴
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 含POI患者(各7例)与正常个体(5例)，source/标题均标注'normal individual'为独立健康供者，miRNA-seq表达平台，可做病例对照差异分析
evidence.correlation: POI患者仅14例，不足16例，无法进行可靠的表达相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: 所有19个样本的source type均为urine，经外泌体分离后测miRNA，按规则尿液外泌体归body_fluid。
